info.title: Valid isn't correct
info.text: Validation checks data is sensible, not true. A birthday of 01/01/2000 passes every check even if it's wrong. Asking twice, called verification, helps catch that.

info.title: Leap years
info.text: A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, except century years, which must divide by 400. So 2000 was a leap year, but 1900 wasn't.

info.title: Double checking
info.text: Websites usually validate in your browser for speed, then again on the server, because a clever user can skip the browser's checks.

info.title: Postcodes
info.text: UK postcodes follow patterns like LLN NLL or LLNN NLL, where L is a letter and N a number. A format check can test for this.

info.title: Why it matters
info.text: Unvalidated input is one of the main ways attackers break into systems, for example with SQL injection, which you'll meet in topic 1.4.

info.title: Casting
info.text: input() always gives a string. int() casts it to a whole number, but it will crash on 'abc', so check it's numeric first.
